guidance: With gross margin now at 30%, we aim to sustain around 29% to 30% gross margin and 13.5% to 14.5% EBITDA margin for the full year.

And this store expansion which you have said of 100 stores if things don't work out, like, then what will be the sales figure for FY28?

focus: We plan to open only 60 to 70 stores in the second half of the year, focus on consolidating operations and sweating our existing 427 stores.
Lastly, on the store addition, you mentioned that you will be adding 60 to 70 stores in H2 and focus on improving the performance of existing portfolio.
We have been targeting and old stores are getting 2,000.
